violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: equipment being put through high temperature dishwasher. EHS did not observe at least 160°F on temp plate.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. EQUIPMENT WILL BE SANITIZED IN 3 COMP SINK UNTIL EQUIPMENT IS SERVICED.

violations.title: Hot Water Sanitizing Temperature Met
violations.observation: Dish plate was observed highest at 155°F. Machine registered final rinse was observed at 190°F.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Repair the dishmachine so that a thermolabel will turn black. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the 3 vat sink to manually wash, rinse and chemically sanitize food-contact surfaces. IN HOUSE TECH TO SERVICE MACHINE.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Restriction & Storage; Medicines Location
violations.observation: Employees' medicines are not properly located to prevent contamination of food and food contact surfaces. Observed cold and flu medicine on top of a refrigerated prep unit and a bottle labeled sleep aid on a shelf above a prep table.
violations.corrective_action: Employees' medicines shall be properly stored to prevent contamination of food and food contact surfaces. MEDICATIONS WERE REMOVED. WOODLEIGH CHASE/THE WILLOWS (Inspection Date: 05/28/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: several utensils were observed with food debris throughout the various kitchens.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. REMOVED FOR CLEANING AND SANITIZING.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: in Horizons split freezer/ fridge unit shepherds pie at 48°F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. FOODS RELOCATED FROM UNIT.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Observed several fruit flies in the main production area of the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence.

violations.title: Chemicals Used on Raw Produce
violations.observation: Chemicals that are being used to wash or peel raw, whole fruits and vegetables do not meet the requirements of 21 CFR 173.315. Chemical vegetable wash was observed above acceptable concentration.
violations.corrective_action: Chemicals used to wash or peel, raw whole fruits and vegetables must be approved as food additives or recognized as safe. CFM REMOVED CHEMICAL FROM USE UNTIL DISPENSER IS SERVICED.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equip/Utensils Self-Draining Position/Covered/Inverted
violations.observation: Observed equipment stored on the shelf next to the 3 compartment sink stacked while wet.
violations.corrective_action: To prevent contamination after cleaning, equipment and utensils shall be stored in a self-draining position that allows air drying and covered or inverted.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: horizons split freezer/ fridge observed at 47°F, later at 51°F. High temp dishwasher is leaking water while in use.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. SERVICE UNITS.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: sides of equipment under the hood in the main kitchen area and exterior of chef base in cafe.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Shellstock Label Marked, Last Date Served/Sold Info
violations.observation: The date when the last shellstock from the container is sold or served is not recorded on the tag or label.
violations.corrective_action: The identity of the source of shellstock (oysters, clams, mussels) that are sold or served shall be maintained by retaining shellstock tags or labels and marking the tag or label with the date when the last shellstock from the container is sold or served. EHS EXPLAINED THE REQUIREMENT.

violations.title: Shellstock Removed from Tagged or Labeled Container
violations.observation: Shellstock tag is removed from the bushel of clams stored in the walk in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Shellstock that has been removed from the tagged/labeled container must have a system used to identify source. EHS INFORMED CFM TO KEEP TAG WITH BUSHEL OF SHELLSTOCK.

violations.title: Gloves, Use Limitation (Single-Use Gloves)
violations.observation: Single use gloves observed improperly used in the following manner: employee with gloved hand put raw burger patty on grill and continued other operations without first removing glove.
violations.corrective_action: If used, single-use gloves shall be used for only ONE task and used for no other purposes. The single-use gloves shall be discarded when damaged or soiled or when interruptions occur in the operation. CFM DISCUSSED WITH EMPLOYEE. EMPLOYEE REMOVED GLOVES.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours. In the walk in cooler, a container of vegetable soup cooked yesterday at 58°F-60°F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. DISCARDED.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: ref prep (L)-fried tofu in container stacked on another item (47°F), salad ref prep (R) hard boiled eggs in container on top of another item (50°F).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. DISCARDED.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: in the ref prep (L), tikka masala (10/13), vegetarian base (10/11). In the walk in cooler, Marsala sauce (10/15/25). Ref prep (L), lentil soup dated for 8 days. In the walk in cooler, tikka masala sauce dated for 8 days.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. DISCARDED. FOODS DATED FOR 8 DAYS, DATES WERE CORRECTED.

violations.title: Hot Water Sanitizing Temperature Met
violations.observation: Dishplate did not read a temperature of 160°F or above.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Repair the dishmachine so that a thermolabel will turn black. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the 3 vat sink to manually wash, rinse and chemically sanitize food-contact surfaces. FACILITY TO UTILIZE SANITIZER AT 3 COMPARTMENT SINK.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: lamb offered to customers preference.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. ADD ASTERISK TO LAMB.
